title: Stinkyscape balance changes I
notes: The owner's first Stinkyscape balance pass (#2521, with #2452): Resources gain the Resource tag and show their Credits; the five Faction cards are renamed and cost (2), and Swear Loyalities exiles only another faction's cards from hand and deck (R2521004); fifteen cards lose Starship Piece and a dead piece fuses its base version (R2521000); Beams, Cannons and Repeaters no longer target heroes, with new damage and uses; the Flaks roll each enemy's damage (R2521001); Meteor, Stratos, ZolarKeth (R2521003), Tmack Trav (R2521002), Pestilent Slime (R2521005), Memory Leak, Starfleet Commander, Yamato Cannon, Paragon-X, Narcor, Red Narcor, Korrelite and four costs change; Going Long and Aluneth lose Quickdraw; Preemptive Strike, Cloaking Module and Star Chart are new (R2521008); CN Tech and NA Tech fall back to hard-coded ends (R2521007); xxFreshJack and Shockwave447 play differently, since the rewritten scripts move cards across the BUSTED and complicated lists they read (R2173001).

player.title: Stinkyscape balance changes I
new: Preemptive Strike, a (2) Legendary Spell: if you have a Dormant Starship, launch it, then Discover a War Doctrine and cast it.
Cloaking Module, a (2) Rare Unit: Starship Piece, Equip, Cloaked and Immutable; its Radiant face is also Immune to Spells.
Star Chart, a token Bob's Plan adds with Alteran Reach: it travels your starscape map 2 nodes (Radiant 4).
Two new tags: Resource, on the six Stinkyscape Resources, and Faction, on the five Faction cards.
balance: ETHICS, Pegasus, Vanguard Coalition, Golden Accord and Star-jumper Core cost (2), down from (3).
Swear Loyalities costs (0), down from (1). Otherworldly Magic costs (2), up from (1).
The Narcor Project costs (3), down from (4). The Syndicate costs (1), down from (2). Memory Leak costs (2), down from (3).
Stratos is 3/1, Radiant 6/2, down from 3/3 and 6/6, and gains Ranged.
Beam v5 deals 12, Radiant 24, down from 15 and 30. Beam v4 deals 7, Radiant 14, down from 9 and 18.
Beam v3 deals 5, Radiant 10, down from 6 and 12. Cannon v5 deals 9, Radiant 18, down from 10 and 20.
Repeater v5 is Activate 4 and deals 3, Radiant 6, from Activate 6 and 2. Repeater v4 is Activate 3 and deals 2, Radiant 4.
Repeater v3 is Activate 3, down from Activate 4.
Meteor's Radiant face deals 15, down from 20.
Starfleet Commander, once Firststrike Capability, is Legendary, up from Common.
changes: Beams, Cannons and Repeaters can no longer target heroes.
Flak v3, v4 and v5 deal a random 1 to 3 damage to each enemy (Radiant 2 to 4, with Lucky 1).
Phalanx, the Prototypes, the Paragons, Halo, Galaxy, Radix, Ozark, Falcon, Yuma, the Badgers and Stratos are no longer Starship Pieces.
A Starship Piece that dies fuses into your Starship as the card it was printed as: no card fused into it and no Buff goes with it.
Swear Loyalities adds the Faction card you swear to and exiles only the other factions' cards in your hand and deck.
Korrelite has Pierce. Narcor adds a random Legendary card. Red Narcor gains 2 mana and draws 1 (Radiant 4 and 2).
ZolarKeth summons a University, not a Radiant one, and each University can be activated at most once each turn.
Tmack Trav's extra attack after a kill on the turn it is played may hit only a Unit, as Rush says.
Pestilent Slime spreads its Plague Counters among your permanents when it dies.
Memory Leak has Crater. Paragon-X is Immune to Spells. Jlockeed's Yamato Cannon's Radiant face has Rush.
Going Long and Aluneth are no longer Quickdraw cards.
CN Tech and NA Tech fall back to Lunar Eclipse and Infinite Reserves instead of random cards.
text: The five faction cards are named Faction: ETHICS, Faction: Pegasus, Faction: Vanguard Coalition, Faction: Golden Accord and Faction: Star-Jumper Core.
Firststrike Capability is renamed Starfleet Commander and is a Human. Resources show the Credits they pay.
